candidates.description: This vector activates for medical conditions, diseases, and related clinical terminology.
This vector is related to microscopic organisms, biological entities, and infectious agents.
This vector represents descriptive adjectives denoting significance, importance, or variation across multiple languages.
These tokens represent modal verbs and auxiliary concepts related to possibility, ability, and obligation across Spanish and English.
This vector activates on words and word fragments starting with the prefix "seg" or containing the Spanish/Latin root for following or cutting.
This feature vector activates on common English transitive action verbs expressing relational, cognitive, or definitional states.
This vector represents word roots and prefixes related to continuation, completion, and concentration.
This vector represents conjugated Spanish verbs indicating tense, aspect, and person.
This feature vector activates strongly on tokens related to breathing, respiration, and words sharing the Latin root "spirare" (to breathe) or similar morphological prefixes.
This feature activates on common Spanish words, prefixes, and morphological roots, particularly those beginning with 'm' or related to comparative and superlative forms.
